## Pull request overview

This PR adds a changeset file to document the bug fix from PR #532 where `defineStack()` Zod parsing was stripping `listViews` from object metadata, causing calendar views to incorrectly render as grid tables. The changeset ensures the fix will be properly versioned and documented in the next release.

**Changes:**
- Added `.changeset/fix-calendar-listviews.md` documenting the console listViews fix as a patch bump
